scripts.dev:server: npm run free-port && npm run dev --workspace=server
scripts.tunnel:serve: npm run free-port && npm run start --workspace=server
scripts.tunnel:all: npm run free-port && npm run build:client && concurrently -k -n server,tunnel -c blue,magenta "npm run tunnel:serve" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:2567 && npm run tunnel:cf"
